metadata.description: Median household income for Black or African American householders (ACS table B19013B), cividis navy (low) to gold (high). Measured over all 32,853 tracts with a published value: 6 classes with breaks at $30k/$45k/$60k/$85k/$120k, which fall at the 13th/31st/48th/68th/84th percentile of the national distribution. Shares its breaks and ramp with the white non-Hispanic style, so switching between the two shows the gap directly; the Census publishes this estimate only where the tract's Black household count supports one. 61.43% have no published value and draw in neutral gray rather than as a low value. 39.96% of tracts have a coefficient of variation above 0.3 at this geography, too many to fade without washing the map out, so read median_hh_income_black_moe in the GeoParquet before drawing a conclusion from any single tract.
